# Gilbert Blythe

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028)</sub>
- **Origin:** Avonlea  <sub>[v1 c30 P32](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0032), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)</sub>
- **Role:** Physician
- **Titles:** Dr. Gilbert Blythe
- **Nicknames:** Gil  <sub>[v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024)</sub>

## Appearance

Gilbert is described as a tall, broad-shouldered, and handsome lad with clear, straightforward eyes. He has curly brown hair, roguish hazel eyes, and a mouth twisted into a teasing smile. Even as a schoolboy, he is noted for his frank and handsome features.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v2 c19 P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

## Personality

Gilbert is popular, competitive, and highly determined in his academic pursuits. He possesses a playful, teasing humor, though he guards his speech and deeds out of deep respect for his ideal of womanhood. He is capable of generous self-sacrifice for those he cares about, such as surrendering a teaching position to help Anne. Loyal and ambitious, he strives continuously to keep himself worthy of high ideals.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P28](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0028), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v2 c19 P51](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0051)_

## History

After returning from Alberta, where he had lived for three years due to his father's health, Gilbert re-entered Avonlea school and initiated an intense academic rivalry with Anne Shirley. During his first day back, he teased Anne by pulling her braid and calling her "Carrots," provoking an angry response and years of cold silence from her. Despite this, Gilbert excelled in his studies and pushed to be top of the class alongside Anne. Upon finishing school, he generously gave up his teaching post at the Avonlea school so Anne could stay close to Marilla, leading the two to finally reconcile and become close friends. As they grew older, Gilbert pursued higher studies and confessed his deeper feelings to Anne, though she initially refused his suit. Later, after surviving a life-threatening case of typhoid fever, Gilbert and Anne recognized their true love for each other and eventually married. He became the local doctor in the Glen community, spending nights treating sick patients and caring for their growing family.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c15 P33](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0033), [v1 c15 P34](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0034), [v1 c30 P24](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0024), [v1 c38 P50](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0050), [v1 c38 P55](../source/v01-c38.md#nw-v01-c38-p0055), [v3 c23 P26](../source/v03-c23.md#nw-v03-c23-p0026), [v3 c40 P9](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0009), [v3 c40 P16](../source/v03-c40.md#nw-v03-c40-p0016)_
